test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Governments around the world need to took dramatic action towards massive investments in health, sanitation, and basic income.

options.text: Governments around the world need to
investments in health, sanitation, and basic income

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the verb "**took**" instead of "**take**."
 
• The modal verb "**need to**" should be followed by the base form of the verb "**take**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**need to take dramatic action towards massive**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Governments around the world need to **take dramatic action towards massive** investments in health, sanitation, and basic income."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "Governments around the world need to"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "investments in health, sanitation, and basic income"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
